export.description: Everything as one Excel file — a sheet per domain, with an ID column so the file can be read back in later.

hints.cruises: One row per cruise. Do not change the ID in column A — it is what matches the row back to its entry on import. New cruises canNOT be created here: a row without an ID is reported as an error, because a cruise with no ship, ports or stops would not be a usable record. Use the form for that.
hints.cruiseStops: One row per port call or sea day. The "Cruise" column points at the "Cruises" sheet through the ID in square brackets.
hints.lodging: One row per property. Stays live on their own sheet, because one property can have any number of them. New properties canNOT be created here: a row without an ID is reported as an error. Use the form, or the CSV import on the lodging page.
hints.lodgingStays: One row per stay. The "Lodging" column points at the "Lodging" sheet through the ID in square brackets. Nights are calculated and cannot be set here.
hints.places: One row per place. Visits live on their own sheet.
hints.placeVisits: One row per visit. The "Place" column points at the "Places" sheet through the ID in square brackets.
hints.flights: One row per flight. Do not change the ID in column A — it is what matches the row back to its record on import. Airports travel as IATA codes; changing a code moves the flight. A row without an ID is created as a new flight.
hints.roadtrips: One roadtrip per row. A row with the ID of one of your roadtrips changes it; without an ID — or with an ID from another account — a new one is created, unless one with the same name and start is already here. Vehicle: motorhome, campervan, caravan, car, motorcycle, bicycle or other. Columns in grey are derived and not imported.
hints.roadtripStations: One station per row. The Roadtrip column points to the Roadtrips sheet by the ID in square brackets – without an ID, the name before it counts. The Order column sets the sequence — 2.5 inserts a station between 2 and 3. Night: stay (with the accommodation in the Stay column), free (no accommodation) or pass (pass-through). A station missing here is kept — except when replacing. Moved into another account, a station keeps its night but not its link to the stay.
hints.tours: Read-only: a tour is measured by its recording, which fits in no cell. Changes here are not imported.

import.title: Excel import
import.description: Play back an edited export file. Rows with an ID change the existing entry. A row WITHOUT an ID only creates something where the sheet allows it — flights, places and visits; on cruises and lodging it is reported as an error. Nothing is written until you confirm.
import.failed: The file could not be read.
import.nothing: The file holds no sheets we recognise.
import.hasErrors: Some rows have problems. Nothing is applied while they are in there.

errors.unknown_id: There is no such ID in your account.
errors.invalid_coordinates: Latitude or longitude is not a number.
errors.invalid_number: A number in this row is not a number.
errors.invalid_date: A date in this row cannot be read.
errors.cruise_needs_id: A new cruise cannot be created from the sheet — use the form for that.
errors.lodging_needs_id: A new property cannot be created from the sheet — use the form for that.
errors.unknown_trip: There is no such trip in your account.
errors.too_many_rows: That sheet has too many rows.
errors.visit_needs_place: A new visit has to name a place — the ID in square brackets in the “Place” column.
errors.unknown_place: There is no such place in your account.
errors.invalid_rating: A rating has to be between 1 and 5.
errors.unknown_airport: That IATA code is not known.
errors.flight_needs_route: A new flight needs From, To, airline and flight number.
errors.invalid_vehicle: TravStats does not know this vehicle.
errors.roadtrip_needs_name: A new roadtrip needs a name.
errors.station_needs_point: A station needs latitude and longitude as numbers.
errors.invalid_night: Night must be stay, free or pass.
errors.station_needs_stay: A night at a stay needs the stay.
errors.station_list_refused: This roadtrip's stations could not be applied.
errors.unknown_roadtrip: The roadtrip named here is neither in your account nor on the Roadtrips sheet.
errors.ambiguous_roadtrip: Several roadtrips have this name — please give the ID in square brackets.

import.modeLabel: What should happen to entries that already exist?

add.label: Add only
add.hint: Creates new entries. Anything already there is left as it is, even where the file says otherwise.

merge.label: Merge
merge.hint: Rows with an ID change the existing entry. Rows without one are created where the sheet allows it (flights, places, visits). Nothing is deleted.

replace.label: Replace contents
replace.hint: Like merge — and additionally deletes everything the file leaves out.

import.replaceWarningTitle: This deletes entries you cannot see right now
import.replaceWarning: Anything missing from the file will be deleted. Those entries are not in the sheet you opened — they are absent from it. A full backup is taken automatically before anything is written, so the import can be undone.
import.confirmReplace: I understand that {{count}} entries will be deleted
import.backupFailed: The safety backup failed — nothing was changed.
import.emptySheetNote: An empty sheet deletes nothing. To empty a domain, remove its rows one by one.
import.readOnlySheets: Cruise stops and stays are exported only. Changes to those sheets are not applied on import.
